hero.title: Virtual Training Programs for Imam University Students – In Partnership with OTAS
hero.paragraph_1: Launch your professional future with the first fully virtual cooperative training program in the tourism and digital technology sector!
hero.paragraph_2: Through a strategic partnership between Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University and OTAS, the leading travel technology platform, we are opening the doors to an exceptional training experience.
hero.paragraph_3: This is not just a set of training hours – it is an intensive hands-on journey through advanced operating systems, big data analytics, content management, digital compliance, financial technology (FinTech), and artificial intelligence – all delivered via interactive training platforms that mirror real-world working environments.
hero.paragraph_4: You will gain modern operational skills that are in high demand in today's market, and you will become part of Saudi Vision 2030's commitment to empowering young national talent. Whether you are a male or female student, this is your opportunity to acquire competitive practical experience, build a professional network, and add real value to your CV – all from the comfort of your own space, at your own pace.
hero.quote: Don't wait for an opportunity like this to come around again. Register now and become one of the changemakers in the digital tourism sector.
hero.note: The programs run entirely virtually on advanced digital training platforms, giving students hands-on training in travel operating systems, data, content, compliance, financial technology and artificial intelligence.

about.title: About the agreement
about.intro: Imam University and OTAS signed this cooperation agreement in order to:
about.goal_1: Strengthen cooperative training for students and prepare them for the job market
about.goal_2: Develop advanced digital learning programs specialised in the tourism sector
about.goal_3: Exchange academic, practical and technical expertise between both parties
about.goal_4: Support Saudi Vision 2030 targets in digital transformation and capability building
about.goal_5: Carry out joint scientific research and build smart technical solutions that serve the community
about.note_financial_title: The agreement is non-financial and serves as a general framework for cooperation
about.note_financial_body: “It does not create, and shall not be construed as creating, any financial or legal obligation…”
about.note_privacy_body: “Both parties undertake to keep information confidential… and to comply with the university’s cybersecurity requirements.”

programs.title: The seven training programs
programs.subtitle: Specialised programs that combine technology and tourism to prepare the workforce of the future. Every program is designed to the highest shared academic and technical standards.
programs.traveltech_text: A technical program introducing modern travel operating platforms such as OTAS.NET, supplier management, building travel sites without code, and understanding API integrations.
programs.media_text: Focused on producing written and visual tourism content, writing travel guides, and creating creative content with artificial intelligence.
programs.languages_title: Languages and international customer service program
programs.languages_text: Specialised in tourism translation, multilingual content, international communication, and handling complaints professionally.
programs.compliance_text: Focused on regulatory compliance, tourism contracts, international regulations, and managing legal risk in the travel sector.
programs.fintech_text: Specialised in financial wallets, settlements, electronic payment, and managing financial risk in the travel sector.
programs.ai_text: Focused on building self-operating intelligent systems, recommendation engines, dynamic pricing, and the Travel AI Agent.
programs.data_text: Introduces trainees to booking data analysis, building dashboards, reading indicators, and feeding artificial intelligence models.
programs.trust: Registration is free and carries no prior financial commitment

international.title: Programs tailored to international students
international.visual_title: The global gateway to digital tourism education
international.visual_text: We connect you to your professional future, wherever you are
international.intro_lead: Imam University and OTAS welcome international students who wish to join the virtual training programs in the tourism and digital technology sector.
international.intro_sub: All programs are available in Arabic, with an English version available on request, as stated in the meeting document:
international.global_content_text: Curricula designed to align with international tourism job-market standards and requirements.
international.fully_virtual_text: Attend interactive lectures and workshops from anywhere in the world, with complete flexibility.
international.certificates_text: Professional certificates issued jointly by the OTAS platform and the IFITT-MENA federation.
international.language_support_text: Training material is delivered in Arabic, with terminology and references provided in English.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.answer_1: Yes. The programs are completely free for students of Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University under the joint cooperation agreement between the university and the OTAS platform.
faq.answer_2: Yes. Every program runs entirely virtually on advanced digital training platforms, so students can attend and practise from anywhere.
faq.answer_3: Yes. Students receive a professional certificate on successful completion, issued jointly by the OTAS platform and the accrediting bodies.
faq.question_4: Can I register for more than one program?
faq.answer_4: Yes. You can register for more than one program subject to seat availability and to your academic timetable.
